headline: BULLISH

action.title: SCALE UP acquisition budget
action.detail: Uptrend is solid. Increase acquisition, prioritise non-stablecoin / active-trader channels (they benefit most in this phase).

reasons: BTC price is 16% above its 200-day average.
The 200-day trend is falling (-5% over the last 90 days).
Price is still 34% below its all-time high.
analysis: Short-term, Fear & Greed sits at 71 (Greed), funding is at a +1.22 z-score (not stretched leverage positioning), the stablecoin supply ratio is 5.40. Realised volatility sits at the 50th percentile of its two-year range (elevated), with Bollinger band width at 18%.

Medium-term, weekly RSI is 60 (neutral-to-firm), the 90-day rate of change is +35%, breadth is 48% of the last 90 days above the 200-day average. The 50/200-day average gap is +8.4%, on the golden-cross side. On-chain activity is expanding versus its own year-average (ratio 1.05). The gap between the headline price gain and this thinner participation is the main tension in this window.

Long-term, price is above its 200-day average (Mayer Multiple 1.16), that average is falling (-5.1% over 90 days), the 200-week multiple is 1.26 (mid-cycle), price is 34% below its all-time high. The Puell Multiple is 1.28, in a normal range for miner economics (context only — not scored). The Pi-Cycle gap is -55.4% (context only — not scored; this measure has historically moved above zero near past cycle tops).

team_notes.marketing: Scale acquisition spend toward non-stablecoin and active-trader channels — the 35% 90-day move gives campaigns a real growth story to lead with; breadth is only 48%, so don't frame this as a broad, settled uptrend; sentiment (Greed) is already warm, so lead with the trend, not FOMO urgency.
